description: This is a shell script for a watchdog mechanism that monitors and manages processes related to the 'beerocks' system. It includes error handling, process monitoring, and logging functionalities. The script's main purpose is to ensure that Beerocks processes are running correctly and to handle stuck or zombie processes.

methods.name: killall_program
methods.description: Kills all processes matching the given program name, optionally with a specified signal.

methods.name: is_program_running
methods.description: Checks if a program with the given name is running, returning true or false.
